scope: Development mechanism experiment on the four already observed generalization-v1 validation groups; no fresh-test claim
statistics: Average paired condition/seed differences within identity; exact two-sided sign flips; Holm over five comparisons; 10000 identity-bootstrap draws, seed 20260920
routing_definition: Fractional reference masks sum to one at every pixel. Outside the supplied damage mask every routed policy uses equal weights. Inside, scalar policies use global softmax weights; regional uses smoothed coarse-region quality/visibility/exposure scores with the existing pose/identity terms and mask-aware global fallback where no region applies.
concat_definition: Original joint softmax over concatenated reference tokens; reuse exact prior all-reference outputs with checked request/output hashes
equal_definition: Average separate per-reference attention outputs; not mathematically identical to concatenated-token attention
limitations: Global FaceID descriptors only, no spatial reference patch features
No learned visibility or pose correspondence
Synthetic supplied masks and medium severity only
